agentRepair.how: The real dispatch entry (packages/envoy-client/bin/dispatch.ts), spawned with DISPATCH_URL set to the harness, on an ask the CLI's session authored. Two real editors broke the decision into 'Which one?' / '- Option A' / 'Context'. Record: https://github.com/sjawhar/legion/pull/2433#issuecomment-6472793457
agentRepair.observed: `dispatch edit-ask --ask <id> --option 'Option A'` exits 1 quoting "Context" and naming dispatch doc-edit; nothing written. Delete path: `dispatch doc-edit --ops-json '[{"op":"delete","find":"Context"}]'` applies, the decision becomes valid (both pages unmarked, row takes Option A), and `dispatch edit-ask --question 'Which one now?' --option 'Option A' --option 'Option Z'` applies. Move path: `dispatch doc-read --blocks` gives the ids, and `doc-edit [{op:move, block:<paragraph>, before:block:<list>}]` applies. The paragraph lands before the decision rather than above its options inside it; the decision is valid, every word is kept, and edit-ask then applies.
agentRepair.verdict: an agent with no editor can follow the refusal to a valid decision with every word it did not delete
